feed.caption:
The week ahead, November 8 – 14 (New Calendar): feasts, saints and fasting at a glance.

We begin with the 23rd Sunday after Pentecost and the Synaxis of the Holy Unmercenaries, together with the Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and all the Bodiless Powers.

Through the week we remember St Nectarius of Pentapolis, the Apostles of the Seventy Erastus, Olympas and their companions, the Martyrs Menas, Victor and Vincent, and St John the Merciful. Friday is the feast of St John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople, and Saturday the feast of the Holy Apostle Philip. Wednesday is a fast day; on Friday fish is allowed.

The Nativity Fast begins on Sunday, November 15, and the Holy Apostle and Evangelist Matthew is remembered on Monday, November 16.
